title: A rational bubble model with momentum
title_zh: 一个带动量因素的理性泡沫模型
title_primary: 一个带动量因素的理性泡沫模型
title_secondary: A rational bubble model with momentum
authors: Feng Liu, Joseph S. White
abstract: Standard rational greater-fool models (e.g., Allen et al., 1993; Liu and Conlon, 2018) generate bubbles but do not generate momentum. Behavioral models with bounded rationality (e.g., Hong and Stein, 1999) generate momentum but do not generate rational bubbles. We expand an existing rational greater-fool model to show how momentum emerges during asset bubbles.
abstract_zh: 标准理性更大傻瓜模型（如Allen等，1993；Liu和Conlon，2018）能生成泡沫，但不生成动量。有限理性的行为模型（如Hong和Stein，1999）能生成动量，但不生成理性泡沫。我们扩展了一个现有的理性更大傻瓜模型，以展示动量如何在资产泡沫期间出现。

title: Monetary transmission with frequent policy events
title_zh: 频繁政策事件下的货币传导
title_primary: 频繁政策事件下的货币传导
title_secondary: Monetary transmission with frequent policy events
authors: Carlo Altavilla, Refet S. Gürkaynak, Thilo Kind, Luc Laeven
abstract: We examine how policymakers’ speeches and monetary policy announcements at official policy meetings transmit to financial markets and the real economy in the euro area. Using high-frequency intraday data across a broad cross-section of financial assets, we introduce the Euro Area Extended Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (EA-EMPD). We refine the identification of monetary policy surprises by exploiting granular, quote-level data on individual market participants’ bid and ask quotes. This novel dataset expands the set of identifiable policy events by an order of magnitude relative to databases restricted to rate-setting meetings. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, central bank speeches move asset prices across all maturities by magnitudes comparable to those of official policy announcements. Second, the relative importance of surprises associated with policy decisions and speeches differs markedly between euro area and U.S. financial markets. Third, speech-induced short-rate shocks transmit to the real economy similarly to official policy shocks, and combining the two sources of policy shocks materially improves the precision of inference. Importantly, even under this much broader definition and measurement of monetary policy impulses, monetary policy shocks account for only a negligible share of fluctuations in real economic activity.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了政策制定者的演讲及官方政策会议上的货币政策公告如何传导至欧元区的金融市场与实体经济。利用涵盖广泛金融资产的高频日内数据，我们构建了欧元区扩展货币政策事件研究数据库（EA-EMPD）。通过利用个体市场参与者买卖报价的细粒度报价级数据，我们优化了货币政策冲击的识别方法。这一新颖数据集将可识别的政策事件集合相对于仅限于利率设定会议的数据库扩大了一个数量级。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。首先，央行演讲对各期限资产价格的影响幅度与官方政策公告相当。其次，与政策决策及演讲相关的冲击在欧元区与美国金融市场中的相对重要性存在显著差异。第三，演讲引发的短期利率冲击向实体经济的传导方式与官方政策冲击类似，且将两类政策冲击结合使用能显著提高推断的精确度。重要的是，即使在这种更为宽泛的货币政策冲击定义与测度下，货币政策冲击对实际经济活动波动的解释份额仍然微乎其微。

title: Commodity Booms, Productivity, and Misallocation: Evidence from Chile’s Administrative Data
title_zh: 大宗商品繁荣、生产率与资源错配：来自智利行政数据的证据
title_primary: 大宗商品繁荣、生产率与资源错配：来自智利行政数据的证据
title_secondary: Commodity Booms, Productivity, and Misallocation: Evidence from Chile’s Administrative Data
authors: Pablo Filippi & Ryan Kim & Ms. Nan Li & María Jesús Pérez & Younghun Shim
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how commodity booms affect productivity using administrative microdata from Chile combining firm exports by product and destination, employer-employee records, and firm-to-firm production networks. Exploiting differential Chinese demand across Chilean commodity products, we measure firms’ exposure to the boom and trace its effects on productivity and resource allocation. We find three mechanisms. First, more exposed firms experience larger revenue increases but no differential productivity gains, channeling revenues into wages and materials. Second, among exposed firms, low-productivity firms expand employment while high-productivity firms do not, hiring workers from more productive employers. Third, domestic suppliers with greater indirect exposure show larger sales and productivity gains. We develop a model with heterogeneous export wedges and labor market frictions in which commodity booms can reduce sectoral productivity by exacerbating input misallocation, consistent with firm-level and aggregate evidence. Calibrated to Chile, this mechanism explains half of the mining TFP decline from 2005 to 2013.
abstract_zh: 我们利用智利的行政微观数据，结合企业按产品和目的地的出口、雇主-雇员记录以及企业间生产网络，研究大宗商品繁荣如何影响生产率。通过利用中国对不同智利大宗商品产品的差异化需求，我们衡量了企业对该繁荣的暴露程度，并追踪其对生产率和资源配置的影响。我们发现三种机制。首先，暴露程度更高的企业收入增长更大，但生产率提升并无差异，收入被导向工资和原材料。其次，在暴露企业中，低生产率企业扩大就业，而高生产率企业并未如此，它们从生产率更高的雇主处招聘工人。第三，间接暴露更大的国内供应商显示出更高的销售额和生产率提升。我们构建了一个包含异质性出口楔子和劳动力市场摩擦的模型，在该模型中，大宗商品繁荣可能通过加剧投入错配来降低部门生产率，这与企业层面和总体证据一致。以智利为校准对象，该机制解释了2005年至2013年矿业全要素生产率下降的一半。

title: On the stability of social risk preferences for health and wealth
title_zh: 关于健康与财富社会风险偏好的稳定性
title_primary: 关于健康与财富社会风险偏好的稳定性
title_secondary: On the stability of social risk preferences for health and wealth
authors: Arthur E. Attema, Olivier L’Haridon, Gijs van de Kuilen
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: This study investigates the temporal and contextual stability of social risk preferences across health and wealth, focusing on both gains and losses. Using a large representative Dutch panel, we replicated the experimental design of Attema et al. (2023) which elicited social risk preferences through allocation decisions involving two anonymous recipients under risk. The design allows us to distinguish three dimensions of preferences: risk preferences, inequality aversion, and social risk preferences arising from trade-offs between risk and inequality, corresponding to utilitarian, ex-ante, and ex-post perspectives on social welfare. At the aggregate level, the main patterns documented in the original study are largely replicated: inequality aversion is prevalent and risk aversion is weaker in the loss domain than in the gain domain. At the individual level, however, stability is more limited. Test–retest correlations are positive but modest, and the proportion of identical choices across waves varies across domains and framings. Parametric estimations further reveal substantial heterogeneity in social risk preferences. A latent-class analysis identifies utilitarian preferences as the largest group, followed by ex-post and ex-ante perspectives. Overall, the results highlight the coexistence of persistence, contextual effects, and heterogeneity in social risk preferences.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了社会风险偏好在健康与财富领域中的时间与情境稳定性，重点关注收益与损失两种情形。利用一个具有代表性的荷兰大型面板数据，我们复现了Attema等人（2023）的实验设计，该设计通过涉及两名匿名受助者在风险下的分配决策来引出社会风险偏好。该设计使我们能够区分偏好的三个维度：风险偏好、不平等厌恶，以及由风险与不平等之间权衡产生的社会风险偏好，分别对应社会福利的功利主义、事前和事后视角。在总体层面，原始研究记录的主要模式基本得到复现：不平等厌恶普遍存在，且损失领域的风险厌恶弱于收益领域。然而，在个体层面，稳定性较为有限。重测相关性为正但幅度适中，各波次间相同选择的比例因领域和框架而异。参数估计进一步揭示了社会风险偏好的显著异质性。潜在类别分析识别出功利主义偏好为最大群体，其次是事后和事前视角。总体而言，研究结果凸显了社会风险偏好中持续性、情境效应与异质性的共存。

title: DP21779 Policy Thresholds as Growth Barriers: Theory and Evidence from a Payroll Tax Notch
title_zh: 政策阈值作为增长障碍：来自工资税断点的理论与证据
title_primary: 政策阈值作为增长障碍：来自工资税断点的理论与证据
title_secondary: DP21779 Policy Thresholds as Growth Barriers: Theory and Evidence from a Payroll Tax Notch
authors: Sami Jysmä, Youssef Benzarti, Jarkko Harju
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Discrete policy thresholds are pervasive in tax and regulatory systems and can substantially distort behavior. We show that notches acting as barriers to mobility within a distribution generate distortions extending far beyond the threshold. The same mechanism biases conventional difference-in-differences estimators, and we propose a new methodology to recover causal effects. Applying the method to the abolition of a size-based payroll tax notch, we find that the notch reduced the number of firms above the threshold by 18 percent and lowered treated firms’ employment, capital stock, and value added by 10 percent, whereas conventional difference-in-differences estimates imply negligible effects.
abstract_zh: 离散政策阈值在税收和监管体系中普遍存在，并可能显著扭曲行为。我们证明，作为分布内流动性障碍的阈值缺口会引发远超阈值本身的扭曲效应。这一机制导致传统双重差分估计量产生偏差，为此我们提出一种恢复因果效应的新方法。将该方法应用于基于企业规模的工资税缺口废除案例，我们发现该缺口使阈值以上企业数量减少18%，并导致受处理企业的就业、资本存量和增加值下降10%，而传统双重差分估计显示的影响可忽略不计。

title: The contributions of community forests to rural prosperity in the United States
title_zh: 美国社区森林对农村繁荣的贡献
title_primary: 美国社区森林对农村繁荣的贡献
title_secondary: The contributions of community forests to rural prosperity in the United States
authors: Reem Hajjar, Susan Charnley, Gregory E. Frey, Kathleen McGinley, John Schelhas 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Community forests (CFs) are a forest ownership and governance approach that enable community members and other key stakeholders to cooperatively manage local forests to produce a range of benefits that align with local community priorities. While well-studied internationally, there is a lack of research that systematically documents how CFs can contribute to rural prosperity in the U.S. amidst ongoing socioeconomic and environmental change. We adapt a framework developed to characterize the contributions of forests to rural prosperity in the international context to investigate the environmental, economic, and social benefits from CFs. In examining 18 in-depth CF case studies, we find that establishing CFs increases access to and control over local forests by local communities, allowing them to manage forests according to local priorities and needs. Economically, many CFs bring in earned income and employment, directly and indirectly, from forest products and services, and support local businesses through tourism and recreation. Social benefits of CFs include access to recreation opportunities, enhancing social relations, and building community identity, security, and empowerment. In extending existing rural prosperity frameworks, we propose that environmental benefits of CFs, including forest protection and restoration and reducing wildfire risk, also play a key role in enhancing rural prosperity. Evidence from these cases suggests that local governance of forests for the production of local benefits using a CF model is a promising approach to enhancing rural prosperity in the U.S.
abstract_zh: 社区森林（CFs）是一种森林所有权与治理方式，使社区成员及其他关键利益相关者能够合作管理当地森林，以产生符合当地社区优先事项的一系列效益。尽管在国际上已有充分研究，但关于社区森林如何在持续的社会经济和环境变化中促进美国农村繁荣的系统性文献仍显不足。我们借鉴了一个为描述国际背景下森林对农村繁荣贡献而开发的框架，用以探究社区森林带来的环境、经济和社会效益。通过考察18个深入的社区森林案例研究，我们发现建立社区森林增强了当地社区对本地森林的获取和控制能力，使其能够根据地方优先事项和需求管理森林。在经济方面，许多社区森林通过森林产品和服务直接或间接带来劳动收入与就业机会，并通过旅游和休闲活动支持当地企业。社会效益包括提供休闲机会、增进社会关系、构建社区认同感、安全感及赋权感。在扩展现有农村繁荣框架的基础上，我们提出社区森林的环境效益，包括森林保护与恢复以及降低野火风险，也在增强农村繁荣方面发挥关键作用。这些案例的证据表明，采用社区森林模式进行地方森林治理以生产地方效益，是提升美国农村繁荣的一条有前景的路径。

title: Migration shocks and voting: Evidence from Ukrainian migration to Poland
title_zh: 移民冲击与投票：来自乌克兰移民至波兰的证据
title_primary: 移民冲击与投票：来自乌克兰移民至波兰的证据
title_secondary: Migration shocks and voting: Evidence from Ukrainian migration to Poland
authors: Dariia Mykhailyshyna, David Zuchowski
abstract: This paper examines the impact of two massive and unexpected inflows of Ukrainian migrants on voting behavior in Poland. In particular, we examine the effects of a conflict-induced labor migration shock and a refugee shock resulting from Russia’s aggression against Ukraine in 2014 and 2022, respectively. Using an instrumental variable approach, we find that greater exposure to labor migrants reduces support for conservative parties in the short run and subsequently shifts voter preferences toward pro-redistribution parties. Exposure to labor migrants as well as to refugees leads to a decrease in far-right voting. This effect emerges only after the salience of Ukrainian migrants increases due to the escalation of Russia’s aggression and the rise of anti-Ukrainian rhetoric from the Polish far-right. The backlash from Polish voters against far-right rhetoric is ten times stronger in areas with stronger exposure to refugees than in areas with greater exposure to labor migrants. Our results are robust to the use of a number of instruments and several sensitivity checks.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了两次大规模且出人意料的乌克兰移民流入对波兰投票行为的影响。具体而言，我们分别研究了2014年因冲突引发的劳动力迁移冲击和2022年因俄罗斯侵略乌克兰导致的难民冲击所产生的影响。采用工具变量方法，我们发现，短期内对劳动力移民的更大暴露会降低对保守党的支持，并随后将选民偏好转向支持再分配的政党。对劳动力移民及难民的暴露均导致极右翼投票减少。这一效应仅在乌克兰移民的显著性因俄罗斯侵略升级及波兰极右翼反乌克兰言论抬头而增强后才显现。波兰选民对极右翼言论的反弹在难民暴露更强的地区比劳动力移民暴露更大的地区强十倍。我们的结果在使用多种工具变量及多项敏感性检验后依然稳健。

title: Tha Alpha Politocal Male
title_zh: 阿尔法政治男性
title_primary: 阿尔法政治男性
title_secondary: Tha Alpha Politocal Male
authors: Marta Reynal-Querol, Mario Francesco Carillo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The alpha male, associated with traditional masculinity features such as competitiveness, assertiveness, and risk tolerance, embodies a biologically grounded dimension of personality. We construct a novel dataset of political leaders' masculinity---measured by facial width-to-height ratio, an established biological marker for traditional masculine behavior driven by testosterone---for more than 2,000 national leaders across 184 countries over 150 years. Leaders’ masculinity has increased over the past 70 years in both democracies and autocracies, across rich and poor countries, and across all regions. Benchmarking against Olympic athletes, Wikipedia-notable individuals, and U.S.\ population data, we document that political leaders exhibit systematically higher masculinity than other groups, in both democracies and autocracies. Leaders' masculinity surges during periods of geopolitical uncertainty, such as the World Wars, the Cold War, and recent decades. Two empirical applications show that masculine leaders are related to democratic change and international war, and these links depend on the institutional environment.
abstract_zh: 阿尔法男性特质，如竞争性、自信和风险承受力，与传统男性气质相关，体现了一种基于生物基础的人格维度。我们构建了一个涵盖150年间184个国家2000多位国家领导人的新型数据集，以面部宽高比（一种由睾酮驱动的传统男性行为的既定生物标志）衡量其男性气质。过去70年间，无论是民主国家还是专制国家、富裕国家还是贫穷国家、以及所有地区，领导人的男性气质均有所上升。通过与奥运运动员、维基百科知名人士及美国人口数据对比，我们发现政治领导人的男性气质在民主和专制国家中均系统性高于其他群体。在地缘政治不确定时期（如两次世界大战、冷战及近几十年），领导人的男性气质显著激增。两项实证研究表明，男性气质与民主变革及国际战争存在关联，且这种关联取决于制度环境。

title: The Growth Effects of Natural Disasters: Evidence From A Novel Global Dataset Over 1970-2023
title_zh: 自然灾害的增长效应：基于1970-2023年全球新数据集的经验证据
title_primary: 自然灾害的增长效应：基于1970-2023年全球新数据集的经验证据
title_secondary: The Growth Effects of Natural Disasters: Evidence From A Novel Global Dataset Over 1970-2023
authors: Ha Nguyen & Mr. Mehdi Raissi & Mr. Bruno Versailles & Alice Tianbo Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We construct standardized climate anomalies from daily observations and carefully calibrate physical thresholds to identify storms, floods, droughts, heatwaves, and cold snaps across 196 countries over the period 1970–2023. Using a local projections framework, we estimate the contemporaneous and 2-year effects of each disaster type and collectively on real GDP growth. We find that storms, floods, droughts, and heatwaves significantly reduce growth on impact (by roughly 0.1–0.2 percentage points on average), with the largest effects observed in emerging markets and developing economies. Cold spells have no statistically significant impacts. Our estimations also indicate that the initial drop in GDP growth is often not fully offset by a quick rebound, leaving GDP below the pre-disaster trend in the subsequent two years. Severe disasters impose far larger costs. Catastrophic floods can lower growth by up to 3 percentage points (with once-in-100-year storms or heatwaves reducing growth by ~0.5pp and extreme droughts by ~1pp). By combining the estimated global coefficients with each country’s own disaster intensity, we translate the aggregate results into localized growth effects and cross-check them against estimates from a dynamic heterogenous panel model. Finally, rolling-window estimates indicate that the contemporaneous growth impact of storms and heatwaves has attenuated in recent decades, whereas droughts have become increasingly damaging, reflecting divergent adaptation or even maladaptation and vulnerability trends over time.
abstract_zh: 我们基于每日观测数据构建了标准化的气候异常指标，并仔细校准了物理阈值，以识别1970-2023年间196个国家的风暴、洪水、干旱、热浪和寒潮事件。通过局部投影框架，我们估算了每种灾害类型及其综合对实际GDP增长的当期影响和两年期效应。研究发现，风暴、洪水、干旱和热浪在冲击当期显著抑制经济增长（平均约0.1-0.2个百分点），其中新兴市场和发展中经济体的影响最为显著。寒潮则未呈现统计显著影响。我们的估算还表明，GDP增长的初始下降通常无法通过快速反弹完全弥补，导致后续两年GDP仍低于灾前趋势水平。严重灾害造成的成本远高于平均水平：灾难性洪水可使增长率下降高达3个百分点（百年一遇的风暴或热浪约降低0.5个百分点，极端干旱约降低1个百分点）。通过将全球估计系数与各国自身灾害强度相结合，我们将汇总结果转化为局部增长效应，并与动态异质性面板模型的估计结果进行交叉验证。最后，滚动窗口估计表明，近几十年来风暴和热浪的当期增长冲击有所减弱，而干旱的破坏性持续增强，这反映了随时间推移出现的适应性分化乃至适应不良与脆弱性趋势的演变。

title: Disappointment looms around the corner: Visibility and businesses’ local market power
title_zh: 失望近在咫尺：可见性与企业本地市场势力
title_primary: 失望近在咫尺：可见性与企业本地市场势力
title_secondary: Disappointment looms around the corner: Visibility and businesses’ local market power
authors: Romain Gauriot, Jeanne Jadeau, Lionel Page
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study whether restaurants in more visible urban locations receive different customer ratings, consistent with consumer-search models in which prominence interacts with search frictions. Using 1.5 million Yelp reviews of 61,000 restaurants in 18 cities across eight countries, we relate ratings to three location-based proxies for prominence: proximity to tourist landmarks, street corners, and public squares. Across specifications with rich controls and user-city fixed effects, restaurants in more prominent locations receive lower ratings. The results are robust to comparing nearby establishments and to checks addressing selection, crowding, and measurement, and we interpret them as consistent with a worse price–quality mix in prominent locations when continued search is costly.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了位于更显眼城市地段的餐厅是否获得不同的顾客评分，这与消费者搜索模型中显眼性与搜索摩擦相互作用的理论相符。基于八个国家18个城市中61,000家餐厅的150万条Yelp评论，我们将评分与三个基于位置的显眼性代理指标相关联：靠近旅游地标、街角和公共广场。在包含丰富控制变量和用户-城市固定效应的多种规格中，位于更显眼位置的餐厅评分较低。这些结果在比较邻近场所及处理选择、拥挤和测量问题的检验中依然稳健，我们将其解释为与显眼位置在持续搜索成本高昂时提供较差价格-质量组合的现象一致。

title: Do grades have absolute meaning? An experiment on majority judgment
title_zh: 成绩具有绝对意义吗？多数判断实验
title_primary: 成绩具有绝对意义吗？多数判断实验
title_secondary: Do grades have absolute meaning? An experiment on majority judgment
authors: Théo Delemazure, Roberto Brunetti, Antoinette Baujard, Sylvain Bouveret
abstract: Whether in education, performance reviews, or elections, grades serve as tools for assessment, yet the universality of their meanings remains an open question. When voting under majority judgment, voters assign verbal grades such as “excellent, very good, good, fairly good, acceptable, insufficient, to reject” to each candidate. The meaning of these grades should be clear and consistent across all voters. Balinski and Laraki (2011) describe this as a “common language” and claim that the grade labels convey absolute meaning. This paper tests the assumption of absolute meaning by examining whether the meaning of a grade depends on the grading scale (i.e., framing effect) in a political context. We conducted an online experiment (N = 1955) in which participants voted for candidates to the French presidential elections under majority judgment with grading scales with different numbers of grades. Our findings indicate that the grade distributions obtained by candidates are significantly influenced by the grading scales available to voters. Our data therefore rejects the assertion that grades convey absolute meaning, showing instead that their interpretation depends on the number of grades available.
abstract_zh: 无论是在教育、绩效评估还是选举中，评分都作为评估工具，但其含义的普遍性仍是一个未解之谜。在多数判断投票制下，选民对每位候选人给予诸如“优秀、很好、好、较好、可接受、不足、拒绝”等口头评分。这些评分的含义应当对所有选民清晰且一致。巴林斯基和拉拉基（2011）将此描述为“共同语言”，并声称评分标签传达了绝对意义。本文通过考察在政治情境下，评分的含义是否依赖于评分量表（即框架效应），来检验绝对意义的假设。我们进行了一项在线实验（N=1955），参与者使用不同评分等级数量的评分量表，在多数判断规则下对法国总统选举候选人进行投票。研究结果显示，候选人获得的评分分布显著受到选民可用的评分量表影响。因此，我们的数据否定了评分传达绝对意义的论断，表明其解释依赖于可用评分的数量。

title: Outside Options, Reputations, and the Partial Success of the Coase Conjecture
title_zh: 外部选择、声誉与科斯猜想的局部成功
title_primary: 外部选择、声誉与科斯猜想的局部成功
title_secondary: Outside Options, Reputations, and the Partial Success of the Coase Conjecture
authors: Jack Fanning
abstract: A buyer and seller bargain in continuous time over a good. Bargainers can be rational or committed to some fixed price. A rational buyer has a private value and outside option. If the set of buyer values and commitment types is rich and the probability of commitment vanishes, outcomes are partially consistent with the Coase conjecture: the seller chooses a price below the maximum of the lowest outside option and half the lowest value; the buyer immediately accepts or takes his outside option.
abstract_zh: 买方与卖方在连续时间内就一件商品进行讨价还价。讨价还价者可能是理性的，也可能承诺于某个固定价格。理性买方拥有私人价值和外部选择权。若买方价值集合与承诺类型集合丰富，且承诺概率趋近于零，则结果与科斯猜想部分一致：卖方选择的价格低于最低外部选择权与最低价值一半中的最大值；买方立即接受或采取其外部选择权。

title: Hunting for Hollanders: The community responsibility system, trade sanctions, and public debt in the late‐medieval Low Countries
title_zh: 追寻荷兰人：中世纪晚期低地国家的社区责任体系、贸易制裁与公共债务
title_primary: 追寻荷兰人：中世纪晚期低地国家的社区责任体系、贸易制裁与公共债务
title_secondary: Hunting for Hollanders: The community responsibility system, trade sanctions, and public debt in the late‐medieval Low Countries
authors: Jaco Zuijderduijn
abstract: To persuade creditors to lend, cities in the Low Countries relied on a community responsibility system that made all citizens personally liable for public debt. This exposed itinerant citizens to significant risks: their merchandise could be confiscated by creditors, and they could even be imprisoned for debt. Although it is usually difficult to assess how such sanctions were enforced in practice, this study examines a unique account of a group of creditors actively pursuing repayment. Their principal debt collector was a monk of the Carthusian order who travelled tirelessly throughout the Lower Rhine region in search of inhabitants of the county of Holland. This monk‐turned‐bounty‐hunter primarily targeted merchants and their goods but also sought to seize financial instruments and real estate owned by Hollanders. Whilst existing literature emphasizes reputation‐based mechanisms to explain polities’ access to credit, this evidence suggests that sanction‐based mechanisms were equally important: reprisals proved effective in recovering debts. Considering that the community responsibility system exposed merchants to sanctions, its survival into the early modern period is quite striking. I argue that the creation of public debt secured political and economic privileges that cities valued more highly than the safety of their merchants.
abstract_zh: 为说服债权人放贷，低地国家的城市依赖一种社区责任制度，该制度使所有公民对公共债务承担个人责任。这使流动公民面临重大风险：他们的商品可能被债权人没收，甚至可能因债务而入狱。尽管通常难以评估此类制裁在实践中如何执行，但本研究考察了一组债权人积极追讨债务的独特案例。他们的主要收债人是一位加尔都西会修士，他不知疲倦地在下莱茵地区奔波，寻找荷兰郡的居民。这位转行做赏金猎人的修士主要针对商人及其货物，但也试图没收荷兰人持有的金融工具和不动产。现有文献强调基于声誉的机制来解释政体获得信贷的途径，但这一证据表明，基于制裁的机制同样重要：报复手段在追回债务方面被证明是有效的。考虑到社区责任制度使商人面临制裁，其存续至近代早期相当引人注目。我认为，公共债务的创造保障了城市高度重视的政治和经济特权，其重要性甚至超过商人的安全。

title: Recreational Marijuana Laws and Racial Disparities: New Evidence on Arrests and Deaths of Despair
title_zh: 娱乐性大麻法案与种族差异：逮捕与绝望死亡的新证据
title_primary: 娱乐性大麻法案与种族差异：逮捕与绝望死亡的新证据
title_secondary: Recreational Marijuana Laws and Racial Disparities: New Evidence on Arrests and Deaths of Despair
authors: Zachary S. Fone, Gokhan Kumpas, Joseph J. Sabia
abstract: Proponents of recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) argue that expanding legal access to marijuana may serve an important social justice objective by reducing racial disparities in arrest rates. Using data from the Uniform Crime Reports and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find support for this claim: RML adoption is associated with a reduction of 498–561 marijuana arrests per 100,000 persons (over 90 percent) among Black adults and a reduction of 128–145 arrests (78–88 percent) among White adults. However, we find no evidence that RML adoption reduces racial disparities in nonmarijuana drug arrests or arrests for property and violent crimes, and post-RML reallocation of policing resources to fight nonmarijuana drug crime and violent crime may, in some circumstances, widen these racial disparities. Finally, RMLs reduce opioid-related mortality among non-Hispanic Whites relative to Blacks and Hispanics, consistent with the hypothesis that those hardest hit at the outset of the US opioid epidemic disproportionately gain from recreational marijuana legalization.
abstract_zh: 娱乐性大麻合法化（RML）的支持者认为，扩大大麻合法获取渠道可通过减少逮捕率中的种族差异，实现重要的社会公正目标。基于《统一犯罪报告》数据并采用广义双重差分法，我们验证了这一主张：RML实施后，黑人成年人每10万人中大麻相关逮捕人数减少498-561人（降幅超90%），白人成年人减少128-145人（降幅78%-88%）。然而，未发现RML实施能缩小非大麻类毒品逮捕、财产犯罪及暴力犯罪逮捕中的种族差异；在特定情境下，RML实施后警务资源向非大麻毒品犯罪与暴力犯罪的重新配置，反而可能加剧这些领域的种族差异。此外，相较于黑人与西班牙裔群体，RML显著降低了非西班牙裔白人的阿片类药物相关死亡率，这与"美国阿片类药物危机初期受影响最严重群体从娱乐性大麻合法化中获益更多"的假说一致。

title: Revisiting J. S. Mill’s methods: causal inference and social choice theory
title_zh: 重访J.S.密尔方法：因果推断与社会选择理论
title_primary: 重访J.S.密尔方法：因果推断与社会选择理论
title_secondary: Revisiting J. S. Mill’s methods: causal inference and social choice theory
authors: Takahiro Suzuki, Masahide Horita
abstract: In his work “A System of Logic”, John Stuart Mill presented four methods of experimental inquiry, structured into five canons, aimed at determining the circumstances that relate to the considered phenomenon by an invariable law. This study delves into Mill’s methods through the lens of social choice theory and discovers the synchronicity between these theories. Our primary finding is that Approval Voting and the Leximax rule are characterized by consistently (and neutrally) extending Mill’s first canon (the method of agreement) and his second canon (the method of difference). Furthermore, we explore the interplay among the five canons. Our findings demonstrate that the Leximax rule successfully adheres to the first four canons while maintaining consistency and neutrality. These results underscore the intricate connection between causal inference and social choice theory, establishing a foundational link for the application of preference aggregation theory to data aggregation in causal inference and vice versa. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 约翰·斯图尔特·密尔在其著作《逻辑体系》中提出了四种实验探究方法，并将其归纳为五条准则，旨在通过不变法则确定与所考察现象相关的条件。本研究从社会选择理论的视角深入剖析密尔的方法，发现这些理论之间存在同步性。我们的主要发现是：批准投票规则和Leximax规则能够一致且中立地扩展密尔的第一准则（求同法）和第二准则（求异法）。此外，我们探讨了五条准则之间的相互作用。研究结果表明，Leximax规则在保持一致性和中立性的前提下，成功遵循了前四条准则。这些发现凸显了因果推断与社会选择理论之间的复杂联系，为偏好聚合理论在因果推断中的数据聚合应用以及反向应用奠定了基础性关联。

title: Robust Tests of Forecast Accuracy for Factor‐Augmented Regressions With an Application to the Novel EA‐MD‐QD Dataset
title_zh: 因子增强回归预测准确性的稳健检验：基于新型EA-MD-QD数据集的应用
title_primary: 因子增强回归预测准确性的稳健检验：基于新型EA-MD-QD数据集的应用
title_secondary: Robust Tests of Forecast Accuracy for Factor‐Augmented Regressions With an Application to the Novel EA‐MD‐QD Dataset
authors: Alessandro Morico, Ovidijus Stauskas
abstract: We present four novel tests of equal predictive accuracy and encompassing á Pitarakis (2023, 2025) for factor‐augmented regressions. Factors are estimated using cross‐section averages (CAs) of grouped series and our theoretical findings are empirically relevant: asymptotic normality, robustness to an overspecification of the number of factors, tractability of different degrees of predictor persistence, and invariance to the location of structural breaks in the loadings. Simulations reveal good local power properties of our tests. We apply them to the novel EA‐MD‐QD dataset by Barigozzi et al. (2024b)—which covers the Euro Area as a whole and its primary member countries—and show that factors offer predictive power.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了四种新颖的预测精度相等性及包含性检验，参照Pitarakis（2023, 2025）的方法，应用于因子增强回归。因子通过分组序列的横截面平均值（CAs）进行估计，我们的理论发现具有实证相关性：渐近正态性、对因子数量过度设定的稳健性、不同预测变量持久性程度的可处理性，以及对载荷中结构断点位置的不变性。模拟实验显示我们的检验具有良好的局部功效特性。我们将这些检验应用于Barigozzi等人（2024b）的新颖EA-MD-QD数据集——该数据集覆盖整个欧元区及其主要成员国——并表明因子具有预测能力。

title: Tariffs, taxes and wages in the age of artificial intelligence
title_zh: 人工智能时代的关税、税收与工资
title_primary: 人工智能时代的关税、税收与工资
title_secondary: Tariffs, taxes and wages in the age of artificial intelligence
authors: John Gilbert, Onur A. Koska, Reza Oladi
abstract: We formulate a model of an open economy with three final goods sectors, one of which uses a continuum of tasks as inputs. Skilled labor or artificial intelligence (AI), which is produced using skilled labor and capital, can conduct these tasks. We explore the effects of technical progress in AI, showing how AI competes with skilled labor in tasks and the consequences for wage inequality and the skill premium. We consider the effectiveness of trade tariffs and a direct AI tax to counter negative impacts of advancements in AI technology on the range of tasks performed by skilled labor.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含三个最终产品部门的开放经济模型，其中一个部门使用连续统任务作为投入。熟练劳动力或人工智能（AI），后者由熟练劳动力和资本生产，可以执行这些任务。我们探讨了AI技术进步的影响，展示了AI如何在任务中与熟练劳动力竞争，以及对工资不平等和技能溢价的影响。我们考虑了贸易关税和直接AI税在缓解AI技术发展对熟练劳动力执行任务范围负面冲击方面的有效性。

title: Leveraging Probability Distortion to Target Prevention: A Cardiovascular Screening Experiment in the Philippines
title_zh: 利用概率扭曲进行定向预防：菲律宾心血管筛查实验
title_primary: 利用概率扭曲进行定向预防：菲律宾心血管筛查实验
title_secondary: Leveraging Probability Distortion to Target Prevention: A Cardiovascular Screening Experiment in the Philippines
authors: Baillon, Aurélien, Capuno, Joseph, Kraft, Aleli, Kudymowa, Jenny, O 等
official: 官方在线 2026-03-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We test whether a conditional cash lottery targets prevention on those doing too little because of inverse-S probability distortion that also causes overvaluation of a lottery. Consistent with theory, Filipinos perceiving their cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk in a wide intermediate interval (10%, 85%] are 3 percentage points (60%) less likely to have a check-up before baseline if they exhibit inverse- S distortion. A random lottery offer conditional on going for a check-up (CVD screening) increases the probability by 47 points overall. Estimates of compliance and lottery-induced CVD preventive care are larger (not significantly) for inverse- S (but also S) types perceiving intermediate risk.
abstract_zh: 我们检验了条件现金彩票是否针对那些因逆S型概率扭曲而预防行为不足的个体，这种扭曲同时导致对彩票的高估。与理论一致，感知自身心血管疾病风险处于宽泛中间区间（10%，85%]的菲律宾人，若表现出逆S型扭曲，则在基线前接受体检的可能性低3个百分点（60%）。一项以接受体检（心血管疾病筛查）为条件的随机彩票提供，总体上将这一概率提高了47个百分点。对逆S型（也包括S型）且感知中等风险的个体，其依从性和彩票诱导的心血管疾病预防护理的估计值更大（虽不显著）。

title: Market integration in the Ottoman Balkans and the Middle East from the sixteenth century until the First World War
title_zh: 16世纪至一战期间奥斯曼巴尔干与中东的市场整合
title_primary: 16世纪至一战期间奥斯曼巴尔干与中东的市场整合
title_secondary: Market integration in the Ottoman Balkans and the Middle East from the sixteenth century until the First World War
authors: Pınar Ceylan, K. Kıvanç Karaman, Şevket Pamuk
abstract: Using a large body of mostly archival price data, this study examines wheat market integration across the Ottoman Empire and puts it in the context of broader European trends. We find that rates of Ottoman market integration fluctuated without a clear trend during the early modern era followed by greater international integration and geographically uneven domestic integration in the nineteenth century. Overall, Ottoman gains were slower than those in western Europe in both periods. Our regression analysis points to the role of geography and technological and institutional changes including changes in state capacity as the main determinants shaping integration patterns.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用大量以档案价格数据为主的数据，考察了奥斯曼帝国境内小麦市场的整合情况，并将其置于更广泛的欧洲趋势背景下。我们发现，在近代早期，奥斯曼市场整合率波动而无明显趋势，随后在19世纪出现了更强的国际整合和地理上不均衡的国内整合。总体而言，奥斯曼帝国在这两个时期的进展均慢于西欧。我们的回归分析指出，地理因素以及技术和制度变迁（包括国家能力的变化）是塑造整合模式的主要决定因素。

title: The Minimum Wage in Firms’ Organizations: Productivity Implications
title_zh: 企业组织中的最低工资：生产率影响
title_primary: 企业组织中的最低工资：生产率影响
title_secondary: The Minimum Wage in Firms’ Organizations: Productivity Implications
authors: Nicholas Lawson, Claire Lelarge, Grigorios Spanos
official: 官方在线 2023-09-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firm organizations are designed to compress unit costs in general, and wage costs in particular. We build on this intuition to study how minimum wages affect firms' organizations, production costs and, ultimately, productivity. To this end, we construct a general equilibrium model in which firms rely on optimal hierarchies to optimize the use of labor and associated knowledge (training). The introduction of a minimum wage constraint in such an environment alters firms' optimal strategies when knowledge acquisition costs are large relative to management costs. We calibrate this model on French data to quantify the impact of the large increases in the minimum wage (up to 8.5% in real terms) that occurred for some firms between 2003 and 2006. We find that the endogenous contraction and flattening responses of firms' organizations strongly contributes to mitigating the overall loss in output (simulated at about 2%). This is driven by gains in revenue productivity (by about 4%) and wages (6.8%), while the impact on quantity-based productivity indices is not monotonic across firm types. These results are confirmed in the French data, both qualitatively and quantitatively, by regression analyses combining difference-in-differences and instrumental variable strategies. Further simulations show that the relative cost of minimum wage constraints tends to be amplified in economies with more efficient communication technologies, and mitigated in economies with more efficient information or problem-solving technologies. However, this last result does not hold for large technological shocks, which suggests that the current waves of new AI-based technologies, as well as the massive investments in communication technologies during the recent Covid-19 pandemic, are likely to necessitate a thorough re-examination of cost-benefit analyses of labor market institutions and regulations.
abstract_zh: 企业组织设计的核心目标在于压缩单位成本，尤其是工资成本。基于这一直觉，我们研究最低工资如何影响企业组织、生产成本，并最终影响生产率。为此，我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中企业通过最优层级结构来优化劳动力使用及其相关知识（培训）的配置。当知识获取成本相对于管理成本较高时，最低工资约束的引入会改变企业的最优策略。我们利用法国数据对该模型进行校准，以量化2003年至2006年间部分企业面临的最低工资大幅上涨（实际涨幅高达8.5%）的影响。研究发现，企业组织的内生性收缩与扁平化调整显著缓解了总产出损失（模拟结果约为2%）。这一调整通过收入生产率提升（约4%）和工资增长（6.8%）实现，但基于数量的生产率指数在不同类型企业间呈现非单调变化。通过结合双重差分法与工具变量策略的回归分析，这些结果在法国数据中得到了定性与定量层面的验证。进一步模拟表明，在通信技术更高效的经济体中，最低工资约束的相对成本会被放大；而在信息或问题解决技术更高效的经济体中，该成本则被缓解。然而，这一结论在面临重大技术冲击时不再成立，这意味着当前基于人工智能的新技术浪潮，以及近期新冠疫情期间对通信技术的大规模投资，可能需要对劳动力市场制度与监管的成本效益分析进行彻底重新审视。
